name: Accordion
description: Renders a ZORA accordion backed by Surface expansion and accessibility mechanics.

name: AccordionItem
description: Renders one opinionated ZORA accordion item over Surface trigger/content primitives.

name: ActivityIndicator
description: Native activity indicator exposed as a serializable ZORA feedback node.

members.type: readonly Readonly<{ name: AccessibilityActionName | string; label?: string | undefined; }>[] | undefined

name: AppBar
description: Renders a top app bar with title/subtitle and optional leading/trailing actions.

name: AppShell
description: Root application frame with explicit header, content, footer, and overlay slots.

name: Avatar
description: Displays a user or entity avatar with image support and initials fallback.

name: AvatarGroup
description: Renders a compact group of avatars with optional overflow handling.

name: Badge
description: Shows a small status, label, or count indicator.

name: BarcodeScannerView
description:
Composed ZORA scanner shell for barcode scanning experiences.

`BarcodeScannerView` is camera-adapter-neutral: pass an `expo-camera`, web,
or test camera element through `camera`; keep permission and fallback UI here.

name: BottomSheet
description: Presents declarative manifest children through the shared Surface sheet host.

name: Breadcrumbs
description: Renders a breadcrumb trail whose final item represents the current location.

name: Button
description:
Theme-aware action control for primary, secondary, destructive, and neutral actions.

Use `Button` for explicit user actions that should follow ZORA's semantic color,
variant, and size recipes across React Native and React Native Web.

name: ButtonGroup
description: Groups multiple `Button` elements with consistent spacing and alignment.

name: CameraPermissionView
description:
ZORA-owned camera permission state for scanner flows.

Native permission APIs stay in app adapters. This component renders the
request, denied, requesting, and manual-entry surfaces consistently.

name: Card
description:
Structured content container with built-in heading, description, actions, and footer slots.

Use `Card` for reusable content blocks that should inherit ZORA spacing,
radius, tone, and responsive header layout without hand-assembling primitives.

name: ChatListItem
description: Chat-style list row with avatar, title, preview text, and unread indicators.

name: Checkbox
description: Binary selection control for toggling a value on or off.

name: CheckboxGroup
description: Renders a group of checkboxes for multi-select values.

name: Chip
description: Compact pill-like control for filters, tags, and quick selections.

name: ChipGroup
description: Renders a row or wrap layout of `Chip` items.

name: CollectionEditor
description: Editor pattern for adding, removing, and reordering a collection of items.

name: compileZoraTheme
description:
Compile canonical theme source into Color Theory evidence and resolved Surface themes.
This function is pure and does not mount React or reproduce owner algorithms.

name: composeZoraPluginMetadata
description: Compose a selected ZORA metadata set for authoring tools that must not load React Native runtime modules.

name: composeZoraPlugins
description: Compose a selected ZORA core/plugin descriptor set into one validated authoring/runtime catalog.

name: createZoraThemeConfig
description: Convert the concise ZORA design seed into canonical persisted theme source.

name: DataTable
description: Displays structured tabular data with responsive desktop/mobile layouts.

members.name: rowActions
members.type: ((row: TRow, index: number) => readonly DataTableRowAction<TRow>[]) | undefined

name: DatePicker
description: Renders DatePicker with anchored web Popover presentation.

name: Dialog
description: Renders the product-level dialog composition on top of the Surface modal primitive.

name: Divider
description: Adapts the themed Surface Divider primitive to ZORA scope and interaction props.

name: EmptyState
description:
Reusable fallback state for empty lists, missing data, or first-run experiences.

`EmptyState` combines concise copy with optional primary and secondary actions
so apps can guide users without custom card and button wiring.

examples.title: Empty project list
examples.code: <EmptyState title="No projects yet" primaryAction={{ label: 'Create project', onPress }} />

name: Field
description: Groups one form control with its label, description, helper text, and field error.

name: FlatList
description: Virtualizes keyed manifest children using React Native FlatList and the Runtime repeat contract.

name: ForgotPasswordForm
description: Password reset form pattern with validation and submit actions.

name: Form
description: Composes explicit form fields, form errors, and submit actions.

name: FormActions
description: Standard submit/action area for forms.

name: FormError
description: Displays a form-level validation or submission error.

name: Gradient
description:
Gradient background container for branded loading surfaces, hero blocks, and previews.

The host supplies a platform-compatible renderer through
`GradientRendererProvider`; ZORA does not require an Expo runtime.

name: GradientRendererProvider
description:
Supplies the host-owned renderer used by `Gradient`.

Expo apps can adapt `expo-linear-gradient` here, while standalone React
Native hosts can inject another compatible implementation.

name: Grid
description: Adapts the themed Surface Grid primitive to ZORA scope and interaction props.

name: Heading
description:
Structured title primitive for accessible page, section, and card headings.

`Heading` gives consumers a ZORA-owned title API with semantic levels,
responsive sizes, and theme-aware emphasis while preserving header semantics.

name: Hero
description: Hero section pattern for prominent page introductions with actions.

name: Icon
description: Adapts the themed Surface Icon primitive to ZORA scope and interaction props.

name: IconButton
description: Icon-only button for compact actions; requires an accessible `label`.

name: Image
description: Displays an image asset and owns its missing, unrenderable, and failed presentation states.

name: KeyboardAvoidingView
description: Native keyboard-aware container exposed through the canonical ZORA feature boundary.

members.type: readonly Readonly<{ name: AccessibilityActionName | string; label?: string | undefined; }>[] | undefined

name: List
description: List composition built on the Surface list boundary with ZORA item/separator policy.

name: ListItem
description: Opinionated list item built on the Surface list-item interaction and geometry boundary.

name: ListSection
description: Section wrapper for lists with optional ZORA section-heading semantics.

name: MediaCard
description: Card layout with an optional media/header region and structured content slots.

name: MessageBubble
description: Message bubble pattern for chat UIs with direction and status styling.

name: MetricCard
description: Highlights a key metric with label, value, and optional trend/actions.

name: MissingElement
description:
Draft-only marker that preserves an unsupported manifest region without faking its capability.

`MissingElement` is intentionally non-interactive and release-blocking in component metadata.
Replace it with a released semantic ZORA element before publishing a production template.

name: OAuthProviderButton
description:
Renders a provider-branded OAuth action button without owning auth behavior.

The component only renders UI and forwards the provider id through `onPress`.
Adapters, redirects, and callback handling belong to app/runtime layers.

name: OAuthProviderList
description: Renders a group of OAuth provider buttons for sign-in and auth settings flows.

name: OtpForm
description: One-time passcode form pattern with digit input and submit actions.

name: Pagination
description: Renders controls for navigating between pages of a finite result set.

name: PaletteItem
description: Tile item pattern for palettes and option grids.

name: PopoverMenu
description: Presents a ZORA-styled action list through the Surface PopoverMenu capability.

name: PostCard
description: Social-style post card pattern with author, content, media, and actions.

name: Progress
description: Progress indicator for determinate and indeterminate loading states.

name: ProgressRing
description: Circular determinate progress with optional serializable center value and label content.

name: Radio
description: Single-choice selection control used within a radio group.

name: RadioGroup
description: Present one controlled single-choice group as inline radios or icon radio options.

name: Rating
description: Displays a read-only star rating with optional half steps.

name: ReaderSurface
description:
Adapter-neutral reader shell for EPUB and PDF experiences.

Supply the actual renderer through `viewport`; ZORA owns only the reader
chrome, controlled state, progress, accessible controls, and normalized
adapter callbacks.

parameters.type: { progress?: number; page?: number; pageCount?: number; }

name: ScanOverlay
description:
Camera-agnostic scan frame overlay for barcode and QR scanning flows.

`ScanOverlay` intentionally renders no native camera. Apps provide camera
capability separately while ZORA owns the visible scan affordance.

name: Screen
description: Screen content boundary with independent width policy and scroll ownership.

name: ScreenSection
description: Screen section with optional heading, description, actions, and content.

name: ScrollView
description: Adapts the token-aware Surface ScrollView primitive to ZORA theme scope.

name: SearchInput
description: Renders a search-focused text input with clear and submit behavior.

name: SectionHeader
description: Section heading pattern with optional description and action slot.

name: SectionList
description: Virtualizes manifest children grouped by explicit section identities and child counts.

description: Renders Select with anchored Popover presentation on web.

name: SignUpForm

name: SkeletonCard

name: SkeletonList
description: Skeleton placeholder list for loading states in list views.

name: SkeletonText
description: Multi-line skeleton placeholder for text content.

name: Surface
description: Adapts the themed Surface Surface primitive to ZORA scope and interaction props.

name: Switch
description: Renders the ZORA switch while preserving the canonical Surface switch contract.

name: Tab
description: Renders one labeled selectable tab backed by Surface accessibility semantics.

name: TabList
description: Renders the accessible list of tabs for a Tabs composition.

name: TabPanel
description: Renders content associated with one selected Tab.

name: Tabs
description: Provides accessible tab state and interaction policy through the Surface Tabs primitive.

name: Text
description:
Structured copy primitive for theme-aware app text.

`Text` owns normal body, caption, label, code, and supporting-copy variants so
consumers do not need to import lower-level Surface typography directly.

name: TextInput
description:
Theme-aware text input with semantic sizing and optional leading/trailing icon slots.

Use `TextInput` for single-line, multiline, and password form controls with ZORA styling.

name: Timeline
description: Timeline pattern for displaying a sequence of events.

name: TimePicker
description: Renders TimePicker with anchored web Popover presentation.

name: Toast
description: Renders a toast notification message with ZORA theme scoping.

name: ToastProvider
description: Provides toast state and rendering context through the Surface runtime host.

name: Toolbar
description: Renders a visible horizontal group of contextual actions and controls.

name: TreeItem
description: Single tree node row used within `TreeView`.

name: TreeView
description: Tree view pattern for hierarchical navigation and expandable lists.

name: Uploader
description: Picks, validates, uploads, previews, and removes one generic file asset.
